data.description:
Discovered from 02c4 during its /rebar-debug close. AC#2 of 02c4 asked to prove the idempotency fix by seeding an unconditional `updated_at` stamp in `clear_absent` and observing the integration test go RED. Runtime investigation proved this is a FALSE PREMISE: `clear_absent` is never reached on a healthy in-window pass — both call sites (`binding_walk.py:254`, `outbound_differ.py:675`) are gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys, and the idempotency fixture seeds all keys in-window, so the seeded mutation left the test GREEN. The delivered guard is at the unit tier (AC#1/AC#4, landed via Gerrit 1911).

Scope: extend the test harness so the moved absence/tombstone cluster (`clear_absent` + siblings in `binding_lifecycle.py`) has an integration-tier mutation oracle that actually exercises an out-of-window path, giving AC#2-style protection a reachable seam. Out of scope for the session that discovered it.
data.title: Add integration-tier mutation oracle for out-of-window binding-lifecycle absence cluster (02c4 AC#2 harness gap)
